title: hosted-request-clarifier-and-sla-routing-for-multi-modal-toolchains
creator: Asha Patel
description: Many incoming enterprise feature requests for the Hosted API are underspecified for routing: customers ask for 'better streaming for toolchains' or 'structured outputs for multi-action flows' without enough info to decide SLA lane, required model variants, or whether Dedicated/Private is needed. This ticket scopes a 'clarifier + SLA router' front-end for intake that: (1) automatically asks minimal clarifying questions to the requester, (2) scores request complexity (streaming + tool calls + structured outputs), and (3) recommends and assigns an intake lane (self-serve hosted, enterprise-hosted SLA, or Private onboarding). Goal is to reduce PM/SE back-and-forth, speed triage, and route high-risk requests to the correct teams earlier.
proposed_solution: 1) Deploy a lightweight classification model in the intake form that detects ambiguity and the presence of multi-output/tool-call/structured-output signals. 2) Trigger a clarifier workflow (2-3 templated questions) to the requester via the support UI/email before human triage if ambiguity score > threshold. 3) Compute a complexity + risk score combining: streaming length, number of external tool integrations, structured schema complexity, and tenant compliance needs. 4) Map scores to routing lanes with deterministic rules and expose recommended lane & rationale to reviewer. 5) Add telemetry and a manual override for PM/SE reviewers. 6) Pilot with top 12 enterprise accounts for 4 weeks, iterate prompts and thresholds.
tradeoffs:
- Clarifier step adds latency to initial acknowledgement (expected +4-12 hours) but should reduce iterative clarifications later.
- Automated scoring may under/over-estimate novel toolchains; requires fallback to human review.
- Building classification + clarification templates requires cross-functional effort (DevRel, Solutions Eng, Legal for data handling).
- If thresholds are conservative, we may route too many requests into enterprise lane increasing load; if aggressive, we may miss risky cases.
acceptance_criteria: Clarifier workflow launches automatically for >=60% of intake requests flagged ambiguous by classifier.
Intake-to-final-triage time (median) reduced by >=35% for pilot customers compared to baseline.
Routing accuracy (human-verified) >=90% for requests involving streaming or tool-calls in pilot sample.
Telemetry dashboard surfaces clarifier rate, average extra latency introduced, routing decisions, and manual overrides.
Documentation updated: intake playbook, clarifier question bank, and routing rules published in Confluence.
Pilot completed and feedback loop incorporated into thresholds/templated questions.
